games.name: Hades
games.award_evidence: BAFTA's 2021 winners release names Hades the Best Game winner.

mechanics.name: run-based escape
mechanics.detail: Each attempt remixes chambers, foes, rewards and story encounters; death returns Zagreus to the House.

mechanics.name: persistent progression
mechanics.detail: Resources improve abilities or unlock weapons between attempts.

mechanics.name: boon builds
mechanics.detail: Olympian blessings combine into different combat builds during a run.

games.return_reason: A failed attempt still advances story, relationships and build knowledge, so mastery and meaning compound across runs.
games.allworld_transfer: Make city missions remix conditions and choices while home, reputation and relationships persist; let agents remember consequences and offer new routes.
games.risk: Meta-progression can flatten challenge; narrative gating can make replay feel like chores.

games.name: Balatro
games.award_evidence: The GDCA organizer's 2025 announcement names Balatro Game of the Year.

mechanics.name: poker hands
mechanics.detail: Play standard poker hands to score blinds, then spend winnings in a shop.

mechanics.name: Jokers
mechanics.detail: Jokers modify scoring rules and create synergies that reshape a deck.

mechanics.name: run modifiers
mechanics.detail: Blinds, antes, vouchers and consumables create escalating constraints and choices.

games.return_reason: Short runs invite one more experiment: a new Joker interaction, economy line or riskier ante.
games.allworld_transfer: Use compact mission chains with combinable skills, contacts and tools; make unusual combinations visibly alter outcomes and unlock achievements.
games.risk: Opaque synergies and luck can feel unfair; optimization may crowd out social meaning.

games.name: Dead Cells
games.award_evidence: The Game Awards' official winner video names Dead Cells Best Action Game in 2018.

mechanics.name: procedural runs
mechanics.detail: Biomes, enemies, routes and loot vary between attempts.

mechanics.name: precision combat
mechanics.detail: Fast melee, ranged and skill loadouts reward timing, positioning and enemy reading.

mechanics.name: permanent unlocks
mechanics.detail: Blueprints and cells unlock future weapons, mutations and options.

games.return_reason: Runs are brief enough to restart, while mastery of movement and enemy patterns makes each attempt feel earned.
games.allworld_transfer: Pair navigable city districts with route choice, escalating mission modifiers and permanent career/tool unlocks that expand agency.
games.risk: High execution demand can exclude players; procedural variety can become cosmetic if optimal routes dominate.

games.name: Returnal
games.award_evidence: BAFTA's 2022 winners release names Returnal the Best Game winner.

mechanics.name: time-loop runs
mechanics.detail: Selene relives a hostile alien planet after death, with rooms and resources changing between cycles.

mechanics.name: bullet-hell movement
mechanics.detail: Dash, jump and weave through dense projectile patterns while firing on alien enemies.

mechanics.name: persistent discoveries
mechanics.detail: Some equipment, traversal abilities and narrative discoveries persist across cycles.

games.return_reason: The loop turns failure into information: players learn rooms, patterns and story fragments, then execute better.
games.allworld_transfer: Make city crises recur with changed variables; preserve discovered facts, trusted contacts and shortcuts so knowledge is a real progression layer.
games.risk: Punishing runs and long sessions can make return costly; repeated failure may feel like loss without enough persistence.

games.name: Vampire Survivors
games.award_evidence: BAFTA's 2023 winners release names Vampire Survivors the Best Game winner.

mechanics.name: auto-attacks
mechanics.detail: The player steers movement while weapons fire automatically into dense enemy waves.

mechanics.name: wave survival
mechanics.detail: Survive timed stages, collect experience and choose upgrades from offered options.

mechanics.name: unlock web
mechanics.detail: Characters, weapons, stages and evolutions unlock through explicit goals.

games.return_reason: Low-input runs create a satisfying power curve, while unlock goals provide clear reasons to try another character or stage.
games.allworld_transfer: Offer accessible city missions where positioning and prioritization matter more than reflexes; use transparent achievement chains to open new careers and neighborhoods.
games.risk: Build choices can become solved; passive play may reduce meaningful agency.

games.name: FTL: Faster Than Light
games.award_evidence: The IGF organizer's 2013 winners release explicitly names FTL the Excellence in Design winner.

mechanics.name: ship systems
mechanics.detail: Assign crew and power across weapons, engines, shields, medbay and other systems during real-time pauses.

mechanics.name: branching star map
mechanics.detail: Choose routes through sectors with encounters, shops, hazards and battles.

mechanics.name: permadeath
mechanics.detail: A destroyed ship ends the run, but knowledge transfers to a new attempt.

games.return_reason: Every run produces stories from constrained decisions, making failure legible and another route tempting.
games.allworld_transfer: Model city life as resource triage across work, home, health and relationships, with branching neighborhoods and irreversible but understandable tradeoffs.
games.risk: Too much scarcity can punish experimentation; opaque event outcomes can feel arbitrary.

games.name: Inscryption
games.award_evidence: BAFTA's 2022 winners release names Inscryption the Game Design winner.

mechanics.name: sacrifice deckbuilding
mechanics.detail: Cards are played onto lanes and many require sacrificing other creatures as costs.

mechanics.name: map choices
mechanics.detail: A branching map offers battles, campfires, traders and strange encounters.

mechanics.name: meta-puzzle shifts
mechanics.detail: The game changes rules, interfaces and genres as discoveries recontextualize earlier play.

games.return_reason: Mechanical mastery is reinforced by curiosity: players return to understand hidden rules and reinterpret prior scenes.
games.allworld_transfer: Let residents and agents reveal deeper city systems through optional investigation, with rules that change as civic knowledge grows.
games.risk: Spoiler-sensitive twists lose force after first completion; genre shifts can undermine a stable mastery loop.

games.name: Outer Wilds
games.award_evidence: BAFTA's 2020 winners release names Outer Wilds the Best Game winner.

mechanics.name: 22-minute loop
mechanics.detail: A solar system resets on a fixed cycle, changing locations and access over time.

mechanics.name: knowledge progression
mechanics.detail: Clues, translations and observations persist in the ship log even when the loop resets.

mechanics.name: open exploration
mechanics.detail: Players pilot freely between planets and discover solutions in any order.

games.return_reason: The player returns because new understanding changes what is possible; discovery, not statistical power, is the progression.
games.allworld_transfer: Build city mysteries whose clues persist in a civic knowledge map; let learned facts unlock routes, missions and agent conversations.
games.risk: Once solved, replay value is limited; pacing depends on players enjoying self-directed investigation.

games.name: Return of the Obra Dinn
games.award_evidence: BAFTA's 2019 winners release names Return of the Obra Dinn the Game Design winner.

mechanics.name: identity deduction
mechanics.detail: Use a supernatural pocket watch to inspect moments of death and identify every crew member's fate.

mechanics.name: evidence linking
mechanics.detail: Names, uniforms, accents, relationships and locations cross-check across scenes.

mechanics.name: nonlinear investigation
mechanics.detail: Cases can be solved in different orders, with confirmed answers validating deductions.

games.return_reason: Progress comes from better reasoning and recognition, so returning means testing a hypothesis rather than grinding.
games.allworld_transfer: Create resident and city cases where social clues, schedules and artifacts form a shared evidence graph with multiple valid investigation orders.
games.risk: Requires careful note-taking and tolerance for uncertainty; weak clue readability creates frustration.

games.name: Papers, Please
games.award_evidence: The GDCA organizer's 2014 winners announcement names Papers, Please the Innovation Award winner.

mechanics.name: document inspection
mechanics.detail: Compare passports, permits and rules to decide who may cross a border.

mechanics.name: time and income pressure
mechanics.detail: Process more entrants to earn wages while paying household costs and handling penalties.

mechanics.name: moral choices
mechanics.detail: Rule compliance conflicts with family survival and requests from people or factions.

games.return_reason: Each day creates a tight decision puzzle, while branching consequences motivate trying different ethical and practical paths.
games.allworld_transfer: Turn careers into accountable choices with visible rules, personal costs and human exceptions; support replay through alternate policies and endings.
games.risk: Moral pressure can feel manipulative if consequences are opaque; repeated inspection can become clerical labor.

games.name: Baba Is You
games.award_evidence: Developer Arvi Teikari's official game page states Baba Is You won IGF 2018 Excellence in Design.

mechanics.name: rule blocks
mechanics.detail: Push word blocks to rewrite rules such as BABA IS YOU or FLAG IS WIN.

mechanics.name: state transformation
mechanics.detail: Changing noun, verb and property blocks alters what entities are and can do.

mechanics.name: world-map progression
mechanics.detail: Solve levels across themed areas, with optional harder puzzles and secrets.

games.return_reason: A solution is a conceptual breakthrough; players return because the same space can be re-read under a new rule.
games.allworld_transfer: Expose city systems as understandable, manipulable rules so players can change roles, permissions and relationships through deliberate experiments.
games.risk: Puzzle difficulty can spike sharply; literal rule systems may not map cleanly to social complexity.

games.name: Cocoon
games.award_evidence: Xbox's official Game Awards recap labels Cocoon the Best Debut Indie Game winner for 2023.

mechanics.name: orb worlds
mechanics.detail: Carry worlds inside orbs, enter them, and use their powers in the larger world.

mechanics.name: environmental puzzles
mechanics.detail: Redirect energy, activate devices and navigate compact alien environments without an inventory.

mechanics.name: boss guardians
mechanics.detail: Each world culminates in a guardian encounter that tests the abilities learned there.

games.return_reason: The game sustains return through elegant escalation: a familiar interaction gains a new meaning when nested inside another world.
games.allworld_transfer: Nest city, home and career contexts so skills and relationships acquired in one sphere unlock actions in another.
games.risk: A tightly authored puzzle arc offers little post-completion replay; nested systems can be hard to teach.

games.name: Portal
games.award_evidence: The official GDCA 2008 archive lists Portal as Game of the Year.

mechanics.name: portal gun
mechanics.detail: Place linked portals on valid surfaces and traverse or redirect objects through them.

mechanics.name: physics puzzles
mechanics.detail: Momentum, gravity, switches, cubes and turrets turn movement into spatial reasoning.

mechanics.name: test-chamber progression
mechanics.detail: Short authored chambers introduce one rule at a time, then combine them.

games.return_reason: The return impulse comes from a clean learning curve and the satisfaction of seeing space differently.
games.allworld_transfer: Teach city systems through small authored missions that reveal one agency rule at a time, then combine them into complex civic goals.
games.risk: A linear puzzle campaign has limited replay once solutions are known; physical rules must remain predictable.

games.name: Portal 2
games.award_evidence: BAFTA's 2012 winners release names Portal 2 the Best Game winner.

mechanics.name: portal traversal
mechanics.detail: Linked portals create routes, launch momentum and redirect lasers, gels and objects.

mechanics.name: co-op coordination
mechanics.detail: Two players solve chambers with four portals, timing and communication.

mechanics.name: puzzle campaign
mechanics.detail: A voiced story introduces mechanics through authored chambers and escalating combinations.

games.return_reason: New tools and combinations keep the learning curve alive; co-op adds a social reason to revisit solved ideas.
games.allworld_transfer: Design paired missions where human and AI agents must coordinate capabilities, with shared credit for solutions and replayable challenge chambers.
games.risk: Co-op depends on reliable partners; authored puzzles lose replay value without variants.

games.name: Braid
games.award_evidence: Game Developer's official May 2006 IGF results name Braid winner of Innovation in Game Design; Darwinia won Visual Art.

mechanics.name: rewind time
mechanics.detail: Reverse or manipulate time to undo movement, deaths and object states.

mechanics.name: world-specific rules
mechanics.detail: Each world changes how time interacts with space, shadows, speed or parallel actions.

mechanics.name: puzzle pieces
mechanics.detail: Time-manipulation puzzles yield pieces that complete each world's picture and advance the journey.

games.return_reason: Players return to reinterpret a puzzle after learning the world’s time rule, turning failure into a reversible experiment.
games.allworld_transfer: Let residents safely rehearse consequential choices, then make different districts obey different social or economic rules that must be understood.
games.risk: Time manipulation can reduce stakes if overused; authored puzzles have limited repeat value after discovery.

games.name: Inside
games.award_evidence: BAFTA's 2017 winners release names Inside the Game Design winner.

mechanics.name: stealth platforming
mechanics.detail: Move through hostile industrial spaces using timing, cover and environmental manipulation.

mechanics.name: possession
mechanics.detail: A control device lets the boy direct bodies to solve spatial and timing puzzles.

mechanics.name: environmental narrative
mechanics.detail: Set pieces and visual clues communicate the world without conventional exposition.

games.return_reason: The player continues to resolve escalating mysteries, while puzzles steadily test timing and interpretation.
games.allworld_transfer: Use silent environmental storytelling and compact missions to make city systems legible through observation, infiltration and consequence.
games.risk: A short linear campaign offers little replay; dark themes may narrow audience fit.
